description: Saturday FIGHT card: the combination sweep + ablation runner that decides shipped defaults. STACK = every currently-surviving (not dead, not not_built) env lever from docs/performance-theory.json, run together, tested against today's shipped baseline. ABLATIONS are computed by fight_card.sh, NOT hand-listed here (stack minus exactly one lever, mechanically derived from `stack.levers` -- this is deliberate: a hand-maintained ablation list can drift out of sync with the stack's own lever list, which is exactly the fork-and-drift failure mode this harness exists to avoid). REVIVAL rows are graveyard candidates that only run when their documented trigger fires; both are currently unmet, so a default run SKIPS both and records why.
note_on_illustrative_lever_names: An earlier verbal brief for this card named ILI_FUSED_GATEUP / ILI_GPU_REDUCE / ILI_METAL_REGION_HANDLES as example STACK members. Verified against c/glm.c, c/backend_metal.mm, c/backend_metal.h, c/compat.h (grep for ili_env(...)/getenv(...) call sites): none of the three exist as implemented env vars today. The closest match, a1-fused-eight-expert-layer-kernel (fused gate/up/SiLU/down MoE kernel), is status pending/pending/not_built in docs/performance-theory.json -- i.e. not yet built, so no flag exists to test. This card's STACK instead uses the three real, currently-implemented, currently-surviving levers (ILI_METAL_PREFILL, ILI_METAL4_MOE, ILI_METAL_PERSISTENT_STATE) plus container path selection. When a1 (or any other not_built lever) actually ships a flag, add it to `levers` and `stack.levers` here.

int4_reference.note: Today's shipped reference container. Used by every row below. Edit this path (or point ILI_FIGHT_CARD at your own card JSON) to your own model directory.

mixed_int4_int2.note: tiered-int4-int2-mixed-precision-container (docs/performance-theory.json) is pending/pending/not_built as of this card's writing: its own 3 gates (MC parity vs int4, long-generation collapse test, +5% frozen-state paired A/B; see c/scripts/run_container_gates.sh) have not yet all passed. Not selected by default_container or any row below. Flip `default_container` (or a row's own `container` override) to this once those gates clear.

levers_field_note: Three values per lever, deliberately distinct: shipped_default_value is what today's real launcher default resolves to (the BASELINE row uses this -- 'what a user gets today'); off_value is the value meaning 'this lever is not contributing to the stack' (every ABLATION row forces exactly one lever to this value, leaving the rest at candidate_value -- 'stack minus one lever'); candidate_value is the on/enabled value the STACK uses. For ILI_METAL4_MOE and ILI_METAL_PERSISTENT_STATE, shipped_default_value == off_value (both opt-in, off today) so the distinction is moot. It is NOT moot for ILI_METAL_PREFILL, which is already shipped default_on: its shipped_default_value (1) and off_value (0) differ, so baseline and 'ablate this lever' are two genuinely different configurations -- collapsing them into one field was tried first and produced a silent bug (ablate_ILI_METAL_PREFILL resolving byte-identical to stack, caught by the --dry-run proof run), which is why this card uses three explicit fields instead of two.

ILI_METAL_PREFILL.note: Already shipped default_on (run-m5max-fast.sh/run-m5max-serve.sh both resolve ILI_METAL_PREFILL:-1). Carried in the STACK at its shipped value (1) so the ablation row (forcing it to off_value=0, i.e. the CPU attention path) shows whether it still earns its keep alongside the newer METAL4/persistent-state levers, not to re-litigate its own already-settled promotion. Kernel-family-rounding note: forcing this to 0 changes CPU-vs-Metal attention arithmetic and MAY fork the output hash vs the stack row -- expected and recorded, not a failure (README.md 'kernel-family rounding can flip greedy tokens'; user ruling 2026-07-14).

ILI_METAL4_MOE.note: confirmed/provisional/retained -- 'rides in the stack' per its own docs/performance-theory.json notes (median +2.05% alone, below the individual +5% bar, kept under the stack-level promote-bar rule). Requires the METAL4=1 lab build (build-m5max-lab.sh + tools/patch_m5max_metal4.py) -- plain `make mac-fast` does not compile this path.

ILI_METAL_PERSISTENT_STATE.note: confirmed(infra)/null/retained -- 0.00%/-0.67%/0.00% paired, kept as lifecycle-safe infrastructure the stack rides on. Requires the same METAL4=1 lab build (patch order: metal4 patched before persistent-state).

excluded_from_stack.reason: opt_in but performance falsified-as-combined-default: confirmed -10% decode cost below 2048 ctx, wins only at long (~4.5K+) CPU-bound prefill context. This card's frozen-state matrix is short-prompt/decode-regime (NGEN=112, moderate prompts) -- exactly the regime DSA is documented to hurt. Included here only as a record of why it is deliberately NOT a stack member, not an oversight.

Serve-mode-only (chunks a monolithic multi-K-token prefill to bound peak memory). This card's matrix reuses ab-m5max-k6-matrix.sh's one-shot `run-m5max-fast.sh ... run PROMPT` machinery -- no monolithic long-prefill scenario for this lever to act on -- regime mismatch, not a finding against it.
Serve-mode-only (trims a GROWING multi-turn agent history). This card's matrix has no multi-turn history at all (each row is a single one-shot prompt) -- regime mismatch, not a finding against it.

excluded_from_stack.lever: n/a (closed-form provisioning guidance, not a runtime flag)
excluded_from_stack.reason: Serve-mode KV-slot count/RAM guidance, not something a one-shot run-m5max-fast.sh matrix exercises at all -- regime mismatch, not a finding against it.

trigger.description: Revive only once measured disk miss bytes per emitted token drop below 1.5 GB. Currently measured figures are well above this (the offline math-verdict record: ~4.2 GB/token at k=8, ~2.75-4.2 GB/token across the Ke sweep; the sketch-draft feasibility analysis: ~3.6 GB/token flat in K for the related sketch-draft design) -- MTP's own K-token verification cost is what a lower miss-bytes/token figure would finally amortize against (falls with cache hit-rate gains and/or the mixed-precision container's smaller expert bytes). Supply the latest measured value with `fight_card.sh --set-measurement miss_bytes_per_token_gb=<value>`; fail-closed by design -- without an explicit measured value on record this row is SKIPPED, never silently assumed met.

PILOT K6's own REGIME CAUTION (docs/performance-theory.json) requires a DECODE-regime change, not a prefill-regime one: 'DSA-aware decode ..., mixed precision, or a materially different cache residency'. Mapped here to two of those three (a3-dsa-metal-decode-extension for DSA-aware decode; tiered-int4-int2-mixed-precision-container for mixed precision) plus dsa-metal-kernel-design-study (the design study gating both). 'a materially different cache residency' has no single tracked id yet -- if one ships under a new id, add it to watch_ids. Checked automatically against docs/performance-theory.json's shipping.code for each watched id at fight_card.sh run time; ANY watched id moving out of {pending, not_built} satisfies the trigger. All three are pending/not_built as of this card's writing, so this row is SKIPPED by default.
